C-DOC-POPOVER-EXPORT-HUB.Name: Titlebar document popover as the file hub: HIG proportions pass plus a one-row quick-export group (PDF / Word / HTML) wired to the existing export commands
C-DOC-POPOVER-EXPORT-HUB.Summary: Owner review 2026-11-07: the document info popover opened by clicking the file name in the title bar (C-40 T-002) feels large and unusable — it mixes a stats card with file actions and offers no export entry. This change gives it an Apple-HIG proportions pass (the same medicine the backlog records for the recently-closed popover) and adds a quick-export row: PDF, Word, HTML. The buttons invoke the existing export commands unchanged — PDF/HTML open the single-page settings dialog (C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE), Word exports directly — so the later "Export without the settings modal" change (C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION) turns the same buttons into true one-click exports without touching the popover again. No new export behavior ships in this change.

Problem.Description: The popover renders name, a meta line, four stat tiles and up to three text buttons with generous paddings; on a typical document it is taller than a macOS menu and reads as a wall of mixed-purpose blocks. Export — the most frequent file-level intent after rename — is absent, so the file's hub misses its main action.

Goals.R-1: HIG proportions pass over the popover shell: compact vertical rhythm (header + one-line meta + stats + actions within roughly the height of a standard macOS menu), consistent 12-13px type, tightened paddings; untitled documents keep the reduced layout (stats + Rename only).
Goals.R-2: Quick-export row: one row of three buttons — PDF, Word, HTML — placed as the primary action group under the stats; labels reuse the File › Export item names; Word is hidden exactly where the tab-menu export group is hidden today (no pathname); PDF and HTML follow their current gating.
Goals.R-3: Wiring is command reuse only: PDF → showExportDialog('pdf'), HTML → showExportDialog('styledHtml'), Word → editorStore.EXPORT_DOCX_DOCUMENT — identical to the File-menu items; the popover closes on click like every other popover action; no payload, pipeline or settings changes.
Goals.R-4: Tests and locales: titlebar unit suite covers the new row (labels, gating, dispatch, popover close); e2e print/export specs stay green unchanged; ten locales reuse existing export label keys where possible and gain at most one popover-section key.

Constraints.Item: No new IPC, capabilities or export behavior; the popover stays pure renderer UI inside components/titleBar.
The design must survive C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION unchanged visually: buttons keep their identity when the commands beneath flip to one-click export.
Popover a11y contract (role=dialog, aria-label) and the existing stats/meta behavior are preserved.
Baseline grace lint current = 0 before editing; final assertions with commands.

NonGoals.Item: One-click (modal-less) PDF/HTML export — that is C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION; this change only mounts the buttons.
Moving settings into the popover, print entry, share-sheet changes, or restyling the recently-closed (↺) popover — separate backlog item.

AffectedAreas.Item: static/locales/*.json (ten locales, at most one new key; reuse File › Export labels)
tests/renderer/components/ (titlebar suite extension), tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts + export-office.spec.ts (regression, unchanged)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-4 done; titlebar unit suite green; the two export e2e specs green unchanged; full vitest run green; grace lint 0 at close.

Live check on macOS (owner): clicking the file name opens a visibly tighter popover; the export row shows three buttons; PDF opens the single-page settings dialog, HTML likewise, Word saves directly; on an untitled document only Rename remains as today.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit: export-row rendering, gating and dispatch assertions plus popover-close; e2e: the C-61/C-NATIVE-DOCX-RTF-EXPORT invoke-order traces unchanged; owner visual smoke of the tightened popover.

Assumptions.Assumption: The popover stays the C-40 component inside titleBar/index.vue (no extraction needed at this size); extraction remains an option for the plan if the template grows past the stats+actions+export shape.
File › Export label keys in the ten locales are suitable for the row (short enough); if a locale overflows, one shared popover key is added instead.
